observations: Large floor-standing multifunction office copier/printer wrapped in plastic sheeting.
Unit has three paper drawers with handles at the base.
Top and front obscured by plastic wrap and stacked papers/magazines placed on top.
A 'KENDO ENTERPRISES' watermark overlays the image — this is the seller/shop's own watermark, not a label on the machine.
No manufacturer nameplate, model sticker, or control panel is visible or legible in the photo.
No power-on, screen, or print-output evidence is visible.

claims.claim: '3140 series sharp printers available' (implying Sharp brand, model 3140 series)
claims.evidence: No brand name, logo, or model plate is visible anywhere on the unit in photo 0; it is wrapped in plastic obscuring any labels.

risks.risk: Actual brand/model unconfirmed — price and specs differ hugely between copier models.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the nameplate/control panel sticker, unwrapped.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic, unidentified floor-standing copier, worst case

risks.risk: Power-on and functional status unknown (scan, copy, print, drawers feeding).
risks.proof: Video of unit powering on, display screen lighting up, and a test print/copy coming out.

risks.risk: Toner/drum/fuser condition and remaining life unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of internal toner cartridge level or a service/maintenance counter printout.
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing full consumable replacement

risks.risk: Physical condition under the plastic wrap (scratches, cracks, missing panels) cannot be seen.
risks.proof: Photos with plastic wrap removed from all sides.

risks.risk: Drawers and paper feed mechanism condition unverified.
risks.proof: Video of each drawer opening/closing smoothly and photo of paper feed rollers.

proof_requests: Unwrap and photograph the brand/model nameplate clearly.
Video of the machine powered on with a test copy/print.
Close-up of toner level indicator or service counter.
Photos of each side with plastic removed to check for physical damage.
response.reason: The item is clearly a floor-standing office copier/MFP by type, but the seller's Sharp 3140 claim is unverifiable since no nameplate or model marking is visible in the photo, so it must be priced as a generic, unverified-condition unit at worst case.
